title: Choose DoulaCloud's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Night Announcement. Keep it, take the pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Night Announcement
options.lineage: letterpress birth announcement cards, printed on dark stock
options.thesis: Every record set like the card a family sends: who, when, and with whom, pressed with care.
options.viewport: Sign in set as an announcement: the greeting as a centered display line, two pressed doors, a foil rule under the heading; Staff screens keep a standard top bar and nav on the aubergine shell.
options.risk: Can tip into wedding-stationery sweetness if the display face is used beyond headings and the greeting.

raised.raise: Every time and date right-aligned in tabular figures, tight to its column edge, as a running time on a tracklist.
Color owns whole regions: the shell and header are aubergine stock, never a gray page with one accent.
One strict tonal ramp of nine steps is the only source of surfaces and text tones, in both themes.

options.label: The Room at 3am
options.lineage: a labor and delivery room at night: dimmed walls, one warm lamp
options.thesis: The app is lit like the room a doula works in at night: dark, calm, one warm pool of light on what matters now.
options.viewport: Sign in on a night-blue field with an amber pool of light behind the door last used; on Staff screens the lamp falls on who is on call tonight.
options.risk: The direction most runs for a calm night tool land on; dark-by-default may read gloomy to an owner at a 9am desk.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Load and conflict drawn as hatching over a zone ramp.
options.viewport: Overlapping translucent sheets with hatch density as load.
options.risk: No doula recognizes a darkroom; hatching is unreadable at 3am.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loses audience and clarity.
options.kept: One strict tonal ramp as the only tonal tokens.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: The schedule as a timed tracklist.
options.viewport: A folded inlay with side A and side B.
options.risk: Handwriting costume on a working screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: personal, but not a practice's tool.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat color.
options.risk: Playful map shapes fight dense records.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loses audience and clarity.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Giant lowercase type as the interface.
options.risk: Cropped giant type hurts a tired reader.
options.kept: Chrome deleted where type can do the job.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Clients as poster tiles in rows.
options.viewport: Rows of tiles, focus expands one.
options.risk: A Practice has no artwork per Client.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no imagery to carry it.
options.kept: The focused row lifts while the rest quiets.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Codes and numbers instead of words.
options.risk: Labels as color codes fail accessibility.
options.case: Fuses poorly: words must stay words.
options.kept: Vast quiet space around one owning element.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Crisp, confident SaaS: what Linear or Stripe would ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A centered sign-in card with two clear buttons on a white field.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
